name: AdaptixC2
summary: GPL-3.0 modular command-and-control framework with a Go teamserver, C++/Qt client, and extensible Windows, Linux, and macOS agents and listeners.
description: AdaptixC2 is an extensible adversary-emulation and post-exploitation framework. Its current extenders provide Beacon and Gopher agents and HTTP/S, DNS/DoH, SMB, TCP, and TCP/mTLS listeners. Threat reporting in 2026 documented its use behind HTTP infrastructure fingerprints, signed-binary DLL sideloading, and a cloud dead-drop channel.
usage: Create a BeaconHTTP listener with a literal lab callback address.
Generate a Windows x64 Beacon with a bounded sleep and jitter.
Task identity, host/directory survey, and one fixed-marker download.
detection: Default teamserver HTTP response headers and its distinctive 404 response body.
Default BeaconHTTP URI, header, User-Agent, response-template, and periodic callback profile.
Server-side TLS fingerprinting such as JARM, qualified by measured specificity.
Signed executable loading a technique-specific DLL from its application directory.
Process ancestry and file/execute patterns associated with delivery and task execution; never rely on a generated agent filename.
